description: This source file generates benchmark statistics for various key types and distributions, specifically for internal hash set probe length analysis in the Abseil library. It includes code for benchmarking different key policies, random allocators, and distribution models, and outputs results in either human-readable or JSON format.

classes.name: Policy
classes.description: Defines key and slot policies for hash set elements, including construction, destruction, and application of functions.

classes.name: RandomizedAllocator
classes.description: A custom allocator that pools allocations and provides randomized address distribution to help analyze hash set probe lengths.

classes.name: DefaultHash
classes.description: Default hash functions for various key types.

classes.name: Table
classes.description: A hash set implementation using the raw_hash_set with custom policies and allocators.

classes.name: LoadSizes
classes.description: Stores minimum and maximum load sizes for hash table benchmarking.

classes.name: Ratios
classes.description: Holds min, average, and max probe length ratios for hash table analysis.

classes.name: Result
classes.description: Stores benchmarking results including key type, distribution, and probe length ratios.

methods.name: output
methods.description: Determines the output style (regular or benchmark) based on command line flags.

methods.name: GetMinMaxLoadSizes
methods.description: Calculates the min and max load sizes for hash table probing analysis.

methods.name: CollectMeanProbeLengths
methods.description: Collects probe length statistics for a given element function.

methods.name: CanRunBenchmark
methods.description: Checks if a benchmark with a given name matches the filter regex.

methods.name: RunForTypeAndDistribution
methods.description: Runs benchmarks for a specific key type and distribution, storing results.

methods.name: RunForType
methods.description: Runs benchmarks for various distributions for a specific key type.
